CustomField.description: The guest's personal feedback survey link, assembled from the booking number and Form_Secret__c. Exists so an email template can merge the link directly; the base address comes from the Gx_Feedback_Setting__mdt Default record, so staging and production each resolve to their own site. Blank until GxFeedbackDispatch has minted a secret.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Personal feedback survey link for this guest. Generated automatically; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Survey Link
